name: icloud-mail-mcp
description: A stateless Cloudflare Workers MCP server for iCloud Mail over IMAP and SMTP.

MCP_LOGIN_SECRET.description: Owner-only OAuth login secret. Generate a random value with `openssl rand -hex 32`; do not reuse your iCloud password.

ICLOUD_EMAIL.description: The iCloud Mail address this Worker will access.

ICLOUD_IMAP_USER.description: The iCloud IMAP username, usually the local part of the email address.

ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD.description: An Apple app-specific password for iCloud Mail, not the normal Apple Account password.
